methodology: Real generated metadata, all settlements, real QuestGenerator and QuestManager matcher at levels 1/5/10. Worlds are independent units; intervals on town proportions use variance across world fractions, never pretend towns are independent. No win rates, travel, safety, rolls, completion or encounter/resource conclusions. Fixed seeded census; CIs characterize sampled world distribution. within150 is hypothetical fallback availability, not production implementation. Representative world traces retained in full rows.
